Approve for **immutable reconstruction only**; 92/95 is a completion/launch gate, not a reason to rebuild.

- Before copying, snapshot/manifest the persistent base; keep it and the v23 rollback read-only. After copying to the original path, re-verify all 177 package hashes and copied Content/source/binary/module metadata; re-run the v24 reference scan there. Check UID 1001 ownership, private permissions, STOP, symlink/path resolution, and sufficient space/inodes on the 150 GB root. Audit restored launch/config files for stale absolute paths or provider-stop bootstrap without printing credentials.
- Recover the three clips from verified baked copies. Otherwise use the original FBX, skeleton and importer settings, logging provenance, settings and output hashes. Require 95/95 exact reference resolution; no substitutes or broad reimport.
- Before any start, verify `.uproject`/engine/plugin/module identity and runtime/driver compatibility, and confirm the effective six-core cgroup. Any code change/rebuild requires separate review. Keep Vagon off and agent STOP enforced.
- Then permit one controlled smoke launch, retaining logs and real HLS plus probe output. Base stability/performance statements only on those captures; make no OOM causal inference.
